name: Curtain Up
description: A night at the musical theatre, from the pit tuning to the curtain call: an overture with brass fanfares, the heroine's 'I want' song, a tap number, a patter song faster than anyone can follow, an eleven o'clock ballad with its key change, a Viennese palace waltz, the villain's tango, a vaudeville soft-shoe, a kickline showstopper and bows to applause. Every tune is newly written in the style of the stage.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Places, Please
sketches.description: The house settles, the oboe gives the A and the pit tunes to it. The lights go down on a timpani roll, and on bar five the overture strikes up with a brass fanfare over running strings.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// Bars 1 to 4: the house settles and the pit tunes; the overture strikes up on bar 5
crowd: s("crowd").slow(4).intensity(.4).gain(.14).fadeout(3, 1)

// The oboe gives the A, then the strings tune to it
oboe: note("a4").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("e").lpf(3000)
  .attack(.1).sustain(.8).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.16).exit(2)
tuning: note("[g3,d4,a4,e5]").s("sawtooth").unison(5).detune(30).vib(5).vibdepth(.15)
  .lpf(1800).attack(.8).sustain(1).release(1.5).room(.6).gain(.06).enter(1).exit(3)

// The lights go down: a timpani roll swells through bar 4
roll: note("c2*16").s("sine").fm(1.2).fmh(1.5).penv(2).pdecay(.06)
  .decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.3).gain(saw.range(.1, .45)).space("hall").enter(3).exit(4)

// The overture: a brass fanfare in C over a running string line
fanfare: note("<[[c4,e4,g4]@3 [c4,e4,g4] [f4,a4,c5]@2 [g4,b4,d5]@2] [[e4,g4,c5]@4 [g4,c5,e5]@4] [[f4,a4,c5]@2 [e4,g4,c5]@2 [d4,f4,b4]@2 [d4,g4,b4]@2] [[e4,g4,c5]@8]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(15).lpf(1600).lpenv(2).lpattack(.03)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.7).release(.4).room(.5).gain(.2).enter(4)
strings: n("<[0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7] [7 6 5 4 3 2 1 0] [3 4 5 6 7 8 9 10] [11@4 ~@4]>").scale("C:major")
  .s("sawtooth").vib(5.5).vibdepth(.1).lpf(2600).attack(.02).sustain(.6).release(.15)
  .room(.5).gain(.14).enter(4)
bass: note("<c2 e2 f2 c2>").s("sawtooth").lpf(500).attack(.02).sustain(.7).release(.4).gain(.3).enter(4)
cymbals: s("<cr ~ ~ ~>").room(.6).gain(.3).enter(4)

sketches.name: The Wanting Song
sketches.description: The heroine's 'I want' song: a soprano over rolling piano in G, strings joining on the second phrase and a lift up a whole step for the second verse.

sketches.name: Taps at Midnight
sketches.description: A tap number under a streetlamp: swung toes and heels on the boards, a walking bass, a sax section on the tune and brass shouts at the end of each phrase.
sketches.source:
setcpm(152/4)

// The tap dancer: toes, heels and shuffles, all swung
taps: s("[click click] ~ click [~ click] click ~ [click click click] ~").swing(4)
  .hpf(1500).room(.2).gain(.28)
heels: s("~ step ~ step").lpf(3000).gain(.2)

// A swinging kit and a walking bass: Bb6, Eb7, F7, Bb
drums: s("rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd], ~ hh ~ hh, bd*4").gain(.24)
bass: note("<[bb1 d2 f2 g2] [eb2 g2 bb2 c3] [f1 a1 c2 eb2] [bb1 f2 d2 bb1]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.48)

// Piano comping on the pushed beats
piano: note("<[d3,f3,g3,bb3] [db3,f3,g3,bb3] [eb3,f3,a3,c4] [d3,f3,bb3,d4]>").struct("~ [~@2 x] ~ x")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(.1).release(.3).pan(.3).gain(.2)

// The sax section carries the tune
saxes: note("<[f4@2 g4 bb4 c5@2 bb4 g4] [bb4@4 g4@4] [a4@2 c5 eb5 f5@2 eb5 c5] [d5@6 ~@2]>").swing(4)
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("o").unison(2).detune(10).lpf(2200)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.6).release(.15).pan(.4).gain(.2)

// Brass shouts answer at the end of every other bar
brass: note("<~ [~ ~ ~ [~@2 [g4,bb4,db5]]] ~ [~ ~ [[f4,g4,bb4,d5]@2 [f4,g4,bb4,d5]] [f4,g4,bb4,d5]]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(10).lpf(2400).lpenv(2).lpattack(.02)
  .attack(.02).decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.1).pan(.6).room(.3).gain(.22)

sketches.name: The Patter Song
sketches.description: In the manner of the comic operas: a tenor rattles off a syllable on every quaver over oom-pah tuba and off-beat brass, and a piccolo trills when he finally takes a breath.
sketches.source:
setcpm(168/4)

// The patter: a syllable on every quaver, faster than anyone can follow
singer: note("<[f4 f4 g4 a4 bb4 a4 g4 f4] [g4 g4 a4 bb4 c5 bb4 a4 g4] [a4 a4 bb4 c5 d5 c5 bb4 a4] [g4 e4 c4 e4 f4@2 ~@2]>")
  .s("voice").syl("<[ta ka ti ka ta ka ti ka] [pi ti ka ta mo di ka ri] [la di da di la di da di] [mo de ra ti va@2 ~@2]>")
  .voicetype("tenor").mono(1).vglide(.02).attack(.02).release(.1).room(.3).gain(.3)

// Oom-pah below and brass on the off-beats: F, C7, F, C7
tuba: note("<[f1 ~ c2 ~] [c2 ~ g1 ~] [f1 ~ c2 ~] [c2 ~ f1 ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(450).lpenv(1).lpattack(.02)
  .attack(.02).decay(.25).sustain(.4).release(.1).gain(.42)
brass: note("<[a3,c4,f4] [bb3,c4,e4] [a3,c4,f4] [bb3,c4,e4]>").struct("~ x ~ x")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(10).lpf(1500).decay(.15).sustain(.2).release(.1).gain(.18)

// Woodblocks keep the clock
blocks: s("rim*8").speed(.8).gain("[.2 .1]*4")

// When he finally takes a breath, a piccolo trills
piccolo: note("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [c6 a5] f6]>").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .decay(.15).sustain(.4).release(.1).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Eleven O'Clock
sketches.description: The big number late in the second act: an alto belts it out over piano chords, the strings swell in, and after a timpani crescendo the whole song shifts up a half step for the last chorus.
sketches.source:
setcpm(66/4)

// The big number: four bars in Eb, then up a half step for the last chorus
const lift = "<0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1>"

// She sings it out, alone in the spotlight
belt: note("<[g4@3 ab4 bb4@4] [c5@3 bb4 ab4@2 g4@2] [f4@2 g4@2 ab4@2 c5 d5] [eb5@6 ~@2]>").add(lift)
  .s("voice").syl("<[ho@3 la mi@4] [no@3 la ma@2 na@2] [so@2 ri@2 la@2 ho a] [o@6 ~@2]>")
  .voicetype("alto").mono(1).vglide(.1).attack(.1).release(1).space("hall").gain(.34)

// Piano chords on every beat: Eb, Cm, Fm7 to Bb7, Eb
piano: note("<[eb3,g3,bb3] [c3,eb3,g3] [[f3,ab3,c4]@2 [f3,ab3,bb3,d4]@2] [eb3,g3,bb3,eb4]>").add(lift)
  .struct("x x x x").s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(.8).sustain(.15).release(.8).room(.4).gain(.24)

// The strings swell in on the second phrase
strings: note("<[g3,bb3,eb4] [g3,c4,eb4] [[ab3,c4,f4]@2 [ab3,bb3,d4]@2] [g3,bb3,eb4,g4]>").add(lift)
  .mask("<0 0 1 1 1 1 1 1>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(20).lpf(2000).attack(.6).sustain(.9).release(1.5).room(.6).gain(.12)
bass: note("<eb2 c2 [f1 bb1] eb2>").add(lift).s("sine").attack(.05).sustain(.8).release(.6).gain(.36)

// A timpani crescendo into the key change, and a crash on the new key
timpani: note("bb1*8").mask("<0 0 0 1 0 0 0 0>").s("sine").fm(1.2).fmh(1.5).penv(2).pdecay(.06)
  .decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.3).gain(saw.range(.1, .5)).space("hall")
crash: s("<~ ~ ~ ~ cr ~ ~ ~>").room(.6).gain(.35)

sketches.name: Waltz at the Palace
sketches.description: Operetta in the ballroom: a quick Viennese waltz in D, strings on oom-pah-pah, sweeping violins, soft horns, a harp glissando and the swish of skirts across the floor.
sketches.source:
setcpm(180/3)

// One cycle is a bar of 3/4, at a quick Viennese lilt
// The strings play oom-pah-pah: D, D, A7, A7, A7, A7, D, D
waltz: note("<[d2 [f#3,a3] [f#3,a3]] [d2 [f#3,a3] [f#3,a3]] [a1 [e3,g3] [e3,g3]] [a1 [e3,g3] [c#3,g3]] [a1 [e3,g3] [e3,g3]] [e2 [e3,g3] [c#3,g3]] [d2 [f#3,a3] [f#3,a3]] [d2 [f#3,a3] ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(1200).attack(.01).decay(.25).sustain(.3).release(.2).room(.5).gain(.22)

// The violins sweep the tune
violins: note("<[a4@2 f#5] [f#5@3] [e5 d5 c#5] [e5@3] [g5@2 e5] [c#5 b4 a4] [d5 f#5 a5] [d6@2 ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(12).vib(5.5).vibdepth(.12).lpf(3200)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.7).release(.3).room(.6).gain(.18)

// Horns hold the harmony
horns: note("<[d4,f#4] [d4,f#4] [c#4,e4] [c#4,g4] [c#4,g4] [c#4,e4] [d4,f#4] [d4,f#4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(900).attack(.3).sustain(.8).release(.6).room(.5).gain(.12)

// A harp sweeps up into the last bar, and a triangle rings every four bars
harp: note("<~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [d4 f#4 a4 d5 f#5 a5 d6 f#6 a6] ~>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.8).sustain(0).release(.8).room(.6).gain(.18)
ding: note("a6 ~ ~").mask("<1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0>").s("sine").fm(3).fmh(3.5)
  .decay(1).sustain(0).release(1).gain(.08)

// Skirts swishing across the floor, and the guests watching
swish: s("pink ~ ~").hpf(2500).lpf(7000).attack(.15).decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .pan(sine.slow(2)).gain(.03)
guests: s("crowd").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(.06)

sketches.name: The Villain's Tango
sketches.description: The villain steps out of the shadows: a bass voice singing and laughing over bandoneon on the 3-3-2, a marcato bass, castanets, a sinister stinger and thunder outside his lair.
sketches.source:
setcpm(116/4)

// The villain steps out of the shadows, singing low: Dm, Gm, A7, Dm
villain: note("<[a2@3 bb2 a2@2 g#2 a2] [d3@4 c3 bb2 a2 g2] [f2@2 e2 f2 g2@2 a2 bb2] [a2@4 ~@4]>")
  .s("voice").syl("<[ah@3 ha ha@2 ha ha] [mo@4 ri ta la ga] [so@2 ni ta ka@2 ma na] [ha@4 ~@4]>")
  .voicetype("bass").mono(1).vglide(.08).attack(.05).release(.6).space("hall").gain(.34)

// Bandoneon chords on the 3-3-2
bandoneon: note("<[d3,f3,a3] [d3,g3,bb3] [c#3,e3,g3,a3] [d3,f3,a3]>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").unison(2).detune(15)
  .attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).lpf(2000).pan(.4).gain(.26)

// A marcato bass, creeping chromatically home
bass: note("<[d2 ~ a1 ~ d2 ~ a1 ~] [g1 ~ d2 ~ g1 ~ d2 ~] [a1 ~ e2 ~ a1 ~ c#2 ~] [d2 ~ a1 ~ d2 [a1 bb1] [b1 c#2] d2]>")
  .s("triangle").attack(.003).decay(.2).sustain(.2).release(.1).gain(.5)

// Castanets in the wings
castanets: s("[rim rim] ~ rim ~ [rim rim] ~ rim rim").speed(1.4).hpf(2000).pan(.65).gain(.16)

// A sinister stinger closes each verse, and thunder rolls outside his lair
stinger: note("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [d3,ab3,c#4]@2]>").s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(25)
  .lpf(1800).lpenv(2).lpattack(.02).attack(.01).sustain(.5).release(.8).room(.6).gain(.22)
thunder: s("<~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [lt ~ ~ ~]>").speed(.4).lpf(300).room(.9).size(.95).gain(.4)

sketches.name: Soft Shoe
sketches.description: A vaudeville soft-shoe with a cane and a straw hat: sand brushed across the boards, light taps, stride piano and a clarinet singing the tune in C.
sketches.source:
setcpm(112/4)

// The sand dance: sand brushed across the boards, swung
sand: s("pink*8").hpf(2000).lpf(6000).decay(.08).sustain(0).swing(4).gain(.05)
taps: s("~ click ~ [click click]").swing(4).hpf(1500).gain(.22)
snare: s("~ sd ~ sd").lpf(2500).gain(.15)

// Stride piano: C, Am, Dm, G7
stride: note("<[c2 [e3,g3,c4] g1 [e3,g3,c4]] [a1 [e3,a3,c4] e2 [e3,a3,c4]] [d2 [f3,a3,c4] a1 [f3,a3,c4]] [g1 [f3,g3,b3] d2 [f3,g3,b3]]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.003).decay(.3).sustain(.1).release(.2).lpf(2400).gain(.26)

// A clarinet sings the tune
clarinet: note("<[e4@2 g4 c5 e5@2 d5 c5] [a4@4 c5@2 e5@2] [d5@2 c5 a4 f4@2 a4 c5] [b4@2 g4@2 ~@4]>").swing(4)
  .s("square").pw(.5).vib(4.5).vibdepth(.08).lpf(1700)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.7).release(.25).room(.4).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Kickline
sketches.description: The showstopper: the whole company in a line, heels hitting the boards on every beat, bright brass on the tune, the chorus singing out and a shout of 'hey!' at the end of each phrase.
sketches.source:
setcpm(144/4)

// The showstopper: a driving kit with a crash every four bars
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ bd ~").gain(.6),
  s("~ sd ~ sd").room(.2).gain(.45),
  s("hh*8").hpf(7000).gain("[.25 .12]*4"),
  s("<cr ~ ~ ~>").gain(.3)
)

// Fifty heels hit the boards on every beat
kicks: s("step*4").lpf(2500).gain(.22)

// A walking bass: C, G7, Dm, C
bass: note("<[c2 e2 g2 e2] [g1 b1 d2 f2] [d2 f2 a2 f2] [c2 g1 c2 ~]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.4).release(.1).gain(.48)

// Bright brass on the tune
brass: note("<[g4@2 c5@2 e5@2 g5@2] [f5@2 d5 b4 d5@4] [a4@2 d5@2 f5@2 a5@2] [g5@4 e5@2 c5@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").unison(2).detune(10).lpf(2800).lpenv(1.5).lpattack(.03)
  .vib(5).vibdepth(.06).attack(.02).sustain(.7).release(.15).room(.4).gain(.22)
saxes: note("<[e3,g3,c4] [f3,g3,b3] [f3,a3,d4] [e3,g3,c4]>").struct("~ x ~ x")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").unison(2).detune(10).lpf(1800)
  .decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).pan(.35).gain(.18)

// The company sings out, and shouts at the end of each phrase
company: note("<[e4,g4,c5] [d4,g4,b4] [d4,f4,a4] [e4,g4,c5]>").struct("x@3 x x@4")
  .s("choir").syl("<ah oh ah hey>").attack(.05).release(.4).room(.4).pan(.6).gain(.24)
shout: note("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ [c4,e4,g4,c5]]>").s("aah").attack(.01).release(.3).room(.3).gain(.25)

sketches.name: Curtain Call
sketches.description: Bows, once: the heroine's theme for her bow, the kickline for the company, a last held chord with a drum fill and a crash, then the house rises to its feet in applause. The form plays a single time and stops.
